= BITwiki User Guide: Creating and Editing Content =

== Executive Summary

This guide provides everything you need to create, edit, and maintain content in BITwiki. It covers basic editing, epistemic marking, template usage, and quality standards.

'''Who This Guide Is For:'''
* New contributors learning BITwiki
* Experienced editors refining content
* Stewards reviewing submissions
* Anyone seeking to understand BITwiki's unique approach

----
== 1. Getting Started

=== 1.1 Your First Edit

'''Step 1: Create an Account'''
# Click "Create account" in the top right
# Choose a username (real names preferred)
# Verify your email
# Read the [[BITwiki_Constitution|Constitution]]

'''Step 2: Find Content to Edit'''
* Browse [[Special:AllPages|All Pages]]
* Check [[BITwiki_Master_Navigation|Master Navigation]]
* Look for pages marked [[:Category:Pages_Needing_Attention|Needs Attention]]

'''Step 3: Make Your Edit'''
# Click "Edit" on any page
# Make your changes
# Preview before saving
# Add an edit summary
# Save

=== 1.2 Basic Editing

'''Text Formatting:'''
```mediawiki
''Italic text''
'''Bold text'''
'''''Bold and italic'''''

== Heading Level 2 ==
=== Heading Level 3 ===
==== Heading Level 4 ====

* Bullet point
* Another bullet
** Indented bullet

# Numbered list
# Second item
## Sub-item
```

'''Links:'''
```mediawiki
[[Page Name]]
[[Page Name|Display Text]]
[[Category:BITwiki]]
[https://example.com External link]
```

'''Templates:'''
```mediawiki
{{Template Name}}
{{Template Name|parameter=value}}
```

----
== 2. Creating New Pages

=== 2.1 Page Structure

Every BITwiki page should include:

# '''YAML Frontmatter''' (required)
# '''Document Header''' (required)
# '''Content Body'''
# '''Categories''' (required)
# '''See Also''' (optional)
# '''References''' (if applicable)

'''Example Structure:'''
```mediawiki
---
title: "Page Title"
description: "Brief description"
type: concept
author: "Your Name"
created: "2026-02-13"
version: "1.0.0"
ontology:
 entity_type: concept
 domain: systems-science
epistemic_status: Emerging
confidence: Established
workflow:
 state: Active
---

{{Documentation}}
[[Category:BITwiki]]
[[Category:BITwiki Concepts]]


= Page Title =

{{Epistemic_Marker
|confidence=Medium
|evidence=Secondary sources
|status=Under review
}}

== Introduction ==

Content here...

== Section 1 ==

More content...

== See Also ==
* [[Related Page]]
* [[Another Page]]

== References ==
<references />


```

=== 2.2 YAML Frontmatter

'''Required Fields:'''

| Field | Type | Description | Example |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `title` | Text | Display title | "BITwiki Constitution" |
| `description` | Text | Brief summary | "Foundational principles..." |
| `type` | Text | Document type | concept, project, source |
| `author` | Text | Creator | "Your Name" |
| `created` | Date | Creation date | 2026-02-13 |
| `version` | Text | Version | 1.0.0 |
| `epistemic_status` | Text | Knowledge tier | Emerging |
| `confidence` | Number | 0.0-1.0 | 0.75 |

'''Optional Fields:'''

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `ontology` | Object | Entity type, domain |
| `workflow` | Object | State, review date |
| `license` | Text | License |
| `sources` | List | References |

'''Example:'''
```yaml
---
title: "Recursive Systems"
description: "Systems that reference themselves"
type: concept
author: "Your Name"
created: "2026-02-13"
version: "1.0.0"
ontology:
 entity_type: concept
 domain: systems-science
epistemic_status: Emerging
confidence: Established
workflow:
 state: Active
license: CC-BY-SA-4.0
sources:
 - "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Recursion"
---
```

=== 2.3 Choosing Page Names

'''Naming Conventions:'''
* Use Title Case: `BITwiki_Constitution` not `bitwiki constitution`
* Be specific: `Recursive_Function` not `Recursion`
* Use underscores for spaces
* Include domain prefix for clarity: `Systems_Recursion`

'''Avoid:'''
* Ambiguous names
* Overly long names (>50 characters)
* Special characters except underscore
* Names starting with numbers

----
== 3. Epistemic Marking

=== 3.1 Understanding Epistemic Status

| Status | Meaning | When to Use |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| '''Axiomatic''' | Self-evident, foundational | Core principles, definitions |
| '''Established''' | Well-supported, consensus | Verified claims, proven theories |
| '''Emerging''' | Promising but incomplete | New research, developing ideas |
| '''Hypothetical''' | Speculative, unverified | Theories, predictions |
| '''Contested''' | Disputed, multiple views | Debated topics, conflicting evidence |

=== 3.2 Setting Confidence Scores

'''Confidence Scale:'''

| Score | Meaning | Evidence Required |
|-------|---------|-------------------|
| 0.95-1.0 | Virtually certain | Multiple primary sources, replication |
| 0.80-0.94 | Highly confident | Primary sources, expert consensus |
| 0.60-0.79 | Moderately confident | Secondary sources, partial evidence |
| 0.40-0.59 | Tentative | Limited evidence, single source |
| 0.20-0.39 | Uncertain | Anecdotal, preliminary |
| 0.00-0.19 | Highly uncertain | Speculation, no evidence |

'''Template Usage:'''
```mediawiki
{{Epistemic_Marker
|confidence=High
|evidence=Primary sources
|status=Verified
}}
```

=== 3.3 Evidence Tiers

| Tier | Description | Examples |
|------|-------------|----------|
| '''T1''' | Primary sources | Raw data, experiments, direct observation |
| '''T2''' | Peer-reviewed research | Journal articles, conference papers |
| '''T3''' | Expert synthesis | Reviews, textbooks, expert opinions |
| '''T4''' | Secondary sources | News articles, blogs, summaries |
| '''T5''' | Tertiary sources | Encyclopedias, general references |

'''Marking Evidence:'''
```mediawiki
This claim is supported by recent research.[1]

== References ==
[1] Smith, J. (2025). "Title of Study." ''Journal Name'', 10(2), 100-120. {{Evidence_Tier|T2}}
```

----
== 4. Using Templates

=== 4.1 Document Header Template

'''Purpose:''' Standardize page metadata

'''Usage:'''
```mediawiki
{{Document_Header
|title=Page Title
|type=Concept
|author=Your Name
|date=2026-02-13
|confidence=0.75
|status=Emerging
}}
```

'''Result:'''
* Adds epistemic marker
* Sets SMW properties
* Displays metadata box

=== 4.2 Infobox Templates

'''Infobox_Concept:'''
```mediawiki
{{Infobox_Concept
|title=Recursive Systems
|definition=Systems that reference themselves
|examples=Fractals, Feedback loops
|domain=Systems Science
|confidence=0.80
|status=Established
}}
```

'''Infobox_Project:'''
```mediawiki
{{Infobox_Project
|title=BITwiki Development
|description=Building recursive knowledge infrastructure
|status=Active
|steward=Hyperion
|confidence=0.90
}}
```

=== 4.3 Epistemic Templates

'''Epistemic_Marker:'''
```mediawiki
{{Epistemic_Marker
|confidence=High
|evidence=Primary sources
|status=Verified
}}
```

'''Uncertainty_Marker:'''
```mediawiki
{{Uncertainty_Marker
|type=Measurement
|value=10.5
|uncertainty=±0.2
|confidence=0.85
}}
```

=== 4.4 Query Templates

'''Related_Entities:'''
```mediawiki
{{Related_Entities
|entity={{FULLPAGENAME}}
|limit=10
}}
```

'''Domain_Index:'''
```mediawiki
{{Domain_Index
|domain=Systems Science
|limit=20
}}
```

----
== 5. Semantic Markup

=== 5.1 Basic Properties

'''Setting Properties:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has title::Page Title]]
[[Has author::Your Name]]
[[Has confidence::0.75]]
[[Has epistemic status::Emerging]]
[[Has domain::Systems Science]]
```

'''Setting Multiple Values:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has domain::Systems Science]]
[[Has domain::Cybernetics]]
```

=== 5.2 Property Types

| Type | Syntax | Example |
|------|--------|---------|
| Text | `[[Property::Value]]` | `[[Has title::Title]]` |
| Number | `[[Property::123]]` | `[[Has confidence::0.75]]` |
| Date | `[[Property::2026-02-13]]` | `[[Has creation date::2026-02-13]]` |
| Page | `[[Property::Page Name]]` | `[[Has author::User:Name]]` |
| URL | `[[Property::https://...]]` | `[[Has URL::https://...]]` |

=== 5.3 Inline Queries

'''Basic Query:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Has domain::Systems Science]]
|?Has title
|format=ul
}}
```

'''Filtered Query:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Has confidence::>0.8]]
|?Has title
|?Has confidence
|format=table
|sort=Has confidence
|order=desc
}}
```

'''Count Query:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Concept]]
|format=count
}}
```

----
== 6. Quality Standards

=== 6.1 Content Requirements

'''Every Page Must Have:'''
* [ ] YAML frontmatter with all required fields
* [ ] Epistemic marker or confidence indication
* [ ] At least one category
* [ ] Clear structure with headings
* [ ] Proper citations for claims

'''Every Page Should Have:'''
* [ ] See Also section with related pages
* [ ] References section if citing sources
* [ ] External links where relevant
* [ ] Images or diagrams if helpful

=== 6.2 Writing Guidelines

'''Be Clear:'''
* Use simple language
* Define technical terms
* Provide examples
* Avoid jargon

'''Be Precise:'''
* Use specific numbers
* Cite sources
* Distinguish fact from opinion
* Mark uncertainty explicitly

'''Be Recursive:'''
* Link to related concepts
* Show connections
* Reference foundational principles
* Acknowledge limitations

=== 6.3 Common Mistakes

| Mistake | Correction |
|---------|------------|
| Missing frontmatter | Add YAML frontmatter |
| No confidence score | Add Epistemic_Marker |
| Uncited claims | Add citations with Evidence_Tier |
| Wrong epistemic status | Review status definitions |
| No categories | Add at least one category |
| Broken links | Check and fix links |

----
== 7. Advanced Features

=== 7.1 Transclusion

'''Include Content from Another Page:'''
```mediawiki
{{:Page Name}}
```

'''Include Specific Section:'''
```mediawiki
{{:Page Name#Section Name}}
```

'''Template Transclusion:'''
```mediawiki

This text won't appear when page is included


This text only appears when included

```

=== 7.2 Subpages

'''Create Subpage:'''
```mediawiki
[[Parent Page/Subpage]]
```

'''Automatic Links:'''
Subpages automatically link to parent with breadcrumb navigation.

=== 7.3 Redirects

'''Create Redirect:'''
```mediawiki
#REDIRECT [[Target Page]]
```

'''Use For:'''
* Alternative spellings
* Abbreviations
* Related terms
* Moved pages

=== 7.4 Magic Words

| Word | Function | Example |
|------|----------|---------|
| `{{PAGENAME}}` | Current page name | BITwiki_User_Guide |
| `{{FULLPAGENAME}}` | Full page name | BITwiki_User_Guide |
| `{{REVISIONUSER}}` | Last editor | Hyperion |
| `{{CURRENTTIMESTAMP}}` | Current time | 20260213110000 |
| `{{NUMBEROFPAGES}}` | Total pages | 500 |

----
== 8. Collaboration

=== 8.1 Edit Summaries

'''Always provide edit summaries:'''
* "Added epistemic marker"
* "Fixed broken links"
* "Updated confidence based on new evidence"
* "Restructured for clarity"

'''Good Summaries:'''
* Describe what changed
* Explain why
* Reference issues if applicable

=== 8.2 Talk Pages

'''Use Talk Pages For:'''
* Discussing major changes
* Proposing new content
* Resolving disputes
* Asking questions

'''Format:'''
```mediawiki
== Topic ==
Your comment. [[User:BITCOREOS|BITCOREOS]] ([[User talk:BITCOREOS|talk]]) 01:04, 24 February 2026 (UTC)

:Reply to comment. [[User:BITCOREOS|BITCOREOS]] ([[User talk:BITCOREOS|talk]]) 01:04, 24 February 2026 (UTC)
```

=== 8.3 Review Process

'''Before Major Changes:'''
# Discuss on talk page
# Get consensus
# Make changes
# Request review

'''After Changes:'''
# Update epistemic status if needed
# Adjust confidence if evidence changed
# Notify relevant stewards
# Update related pages

----
== 9. Troubleshooting

=== 9.1 Common Issues

'''SMW Properties Not Showing:'''
* Check property syntax: `[[Property::Value]]`
* Verify property exists in Property: namespace
* Rebuild semantic data (ask steward)

'''Template Errors:'''
* Check parameter names
* Verify template exists
* Check for missing closing brackets

'''Broken Links:'''
* Check page exists
* Verify spelling
* Use Special:Search to find correct name

=== 9.2 Getting Help

'''Resources:'''
* [[BITwiki_FAQ|FAQ]]
* [[BITwiki_Master_Navigation|Master Navigation]]
* [[Special:AllPages|All Pages]]
* [[:Category:Help|Help Category]]

'''Contact:'''
* Talk pages for specific questions
* Stewards for policy questions
* [[BITwiki_Community_Portal|Community Portal]]

----
== 10. Quick Reference

=== 10.1 Cheat Sheet

```mediawiki
=== Headings ===
''Italic''  '''Bold'''
[[Link]]  [[Link|Text]]
[https://example.com External]

* Bullet
# Number

{{Template}}
{{Template|param=value}}

[[Category:Name]]
[[Has property::Value]]

{{#ask: [[Property::Value]]
|?Other property
|format=table
}}
```

=== 10.2 Epistemic Quick Reference

| Status | Confidence | Evidence | Template |
|--------|------------|----------|----------|
| Axiomatic | 1.0 | Self-evident | `{{Epistemic_Marker|confidence=Certain|evidence=Axiomatic|status=Verified}}` |
| Established | 0.8-0.99 | Primary | `{{Epistemic_Marker|confidence=High|evidence=Primary sources|status=Verified}}` |
| Emerging | 0.5-0.79 | Secondary | `{{Epistemic_Marker|confidence=Medium|evidence=Secondary sources|status=Under review}}` |
| Hypothetical | 0.0-0.49 | Tertiary | `{{Epistemic_Marker|confidence=Low|evidence=Preliminary|status=Unverified}}` |
| Contested | Variable | Mixed | `{{Epistemic_Marker|confidence=Variable|evidence=Mixed|status=Disputed}}` |

----
== Conclusion

BITwiki is a recursive knowledge system that requires explicit epistemic marking. By following these guidelines, you contribute to a knowledge base that is transparent, verifiable, and machine-readable.

'''Remember:'''
* Mark your confidence honestly
* Cite your sources
* Link to related concepts
* Be open to revision

'''Next Steps:'''
# Create your first page
# Join the community
# Review the [[BITwiki_Constitution|Constitution]]
# Explore [[BITwiki_Master_Navigation|Master Navigation]]

== 6. Quality Standards

=== 6.1 Content Requirements

'''Every Page Must Have:'''
* [ ] YAML frontmatter with all required fields
* [ ] Epistemic marker or confidence indication
* [ ] At least one category
* [ ] Clear structure with headings
* [ ] Proper citations for claims

'''Every Page Should Have:'''
* [ ] See Also section with related pages
* [ ] References section if citing sources
* [ ] External links where relevant
* [ ] Images or diagrams if helpful

=== 6.2 Writing Guidelines

'''Be Clear:'''
* Use simple language
* Define technical terms
* Provide examples
* Avoid jargon

'''Be Precise:'''
* Use specific numbers
* Cite sources
* Distinguish fact from opinion
* Mark uncertainty explicitly

'''Be Recursive:'''
* Link to related concepts
* Show connections
* Reference foundational principles
* Acknowledge limitations

| Mistake | Correction |
|---------|------------|
| Missing frontmatter | Add YAML frontmatter |
| No confidence score | Add Epistemic_Marker |
| Uncited claims | Add citations with Evidence_Tier |
| Wrong epistemic status | Review status definitions |
| No categories | Add at least one category |
| Broken links | Check and fix links |

----
== 7. Advanced Features

</includeonly>
```

=== 7.2 Subpages

```

Subpages automatically link to parent with breadcrumb navigation.

=== 7.3 Redirects

'''Create Redirect:'''
```mediawiki

```

* Abbreviations
* Related terms
* Moved pages

----
== 8. Collaboration

=== 8.1 Edit Summaries

'''Always provide edit summaries:'''

= BITwiki User Guide: Creating and Editing Content =

== Executive Summary

This guide provides everything you need to create, edit, and maintain content in BITwiki. It covers basic editing, epistemic marking, template usage, and quality standards.

'''Who This Guide Is For:'''
* New contributors learning BITwiki
* Experienced editors refining content
* Stewards reviewing submissions
* Anyone seeking to understand BITwiki's unique approach

----
== 1. Getting Started

=== 1.1 Your First Edit

'''Step 1: Create an Account'''
# Click "Create account" in the top right
# Choose a username (real names preferred)
# Verify your email
# Read the [[BITwiki_Constitution|Constitution]]

'''Step 2: Find Content to Edit'''
* Browse [[Special:AllPages|All Pages]]
* Check [[BITwiki_Master_Navigation|Master Navigation]]
* Look for pages marked [[:Category:Pages_Needing_Attention|Needs Attention]]

'''Step 3: Make Your Edit'''
# Click "Edit" on any page
# Make your changes
# Preview before saving
# Add an edit summary
# Save

=== 1.2 Basic Editing

'''Text Formatting:'''
```mediawiki
''Italic text''
'''Bold text'''
'''''Bold and italic'''''

== Heading Level 2 ==
=== Heading Level 3 ===
==== Heading Level 4 ====

* Bullet point
* Another bullet
** Indented bullet

# Numbered list
# Second item
## Sub-item
```

'''Links:'''
```mediawiki
[[Page Name]]
[[Page Name|Display Text]]
[[Category:BITwiki]]
[https://example.com External link]
```

'''Templates:'''
```mediawiki
{{Template Name}}
{{Template Name|parameter=value}}
```

----
== 2. Creating New Pages

=== 2.1 Page Structure

Every BITwiki page should include:

# '''YAML Frontmatter''' (required)
# '''Document Header''' (required)
# '''Content Body'''
# '''Categories''' (required)
# '''See Also''' (optional)
# '''References''' (if applicable)

'''Example Structure:'''
```mediawiki
---
title: "Page Title"
description: "Brief description"
type: concept
author: "Your Name"
created: "2026-02-13"
version: "1.0.0"
ontology:
 entity_type: concept
 domain: systems-science
epistemic_status: Emerging
confidence: Established
workflow:
 state: Active
---

<noinclude>{{Documentation}}
[[Category:BITwiki]]
[[Category:BITwiki Concepts]]
</noinclude><includeonly>

= Page Title =

{{Epistemic_Marker
|confidence=Medium
|evidence=Secondary sources
|status=Under review
}}

== Introduction ==

Content here...

== Section 1 ==

More content...

== See Also ==
* [[Related Page]]
* [[Another Page]]

== References ==
<references />

</includeonly>
```

=== 2.2 YAML Frontmatter

'''Required Fields:'''

| Field | Type | Description | Example |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `title` | Text | Display title | "BITwiki Constitution" |
| `description` | Text | Brief summary | "Foundational principles..." |
| `type` | Text | Document type | concept, project, source |
| `author` | Text | Creator | "Your Name" |
| `created` | Date | Creation date | 2026-02-13 |
| `version` | Text | Version | 1.0.0 |
| `epistemic_status` | Text | Knowledge tier | Emerging |
| `confidence` | Number | 0.0-1.0 | 0.75 |

'''Optional Fields:'''

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `ontology` | Object | Entity type, domain |
| `workflow` | Object | State, review date |
| `license` | Text | License |
| `sources` | List | References |

'''Example:'''
```yaml
---
title: "Recursive Systems"
description: "Systems that reference themselves"
type: concept
author: "Your Name"
created: "2026-02-13"
version: "1.0.0"
ontology:
 entity_type: concept
 domain: systems-science
epistemic_status: Emerging
confidence: Established
workflow:
 state: Active
license: CC-BY-SA-4.0
sources:
 - "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Recursion"
---
```

=== 2.3 Choosing Page Names

'''Naming Conventions:'''
* Use Title Case: `BITwiki_Constitution` not `bitwiki constitution`
* Be specific: `Recursive_Function` not `Recursion`
* Use underscores for spaces
* Include domain prefix for clarity: `Systems_Recursion`

'''Avoid:'''
* Ambiguous names
* Overly long names (>50 characters)
* Special characters except underscore
* Names starting with numbers

----
== 3. Epistemic Marking

=== 3.1 Understanding Epistemic Status

| Status | Meaning | When to Use |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| '''Axiomatic''' | Self-evident, foundational | Core principles, definitions |
| '''Established''' | Well-supported, consensus | Verified claims, proven theories |
| '''Emerging''' | Promising but incomplete | New research, developing ideas |
| '''Hypothetical''' | Speculative, unverified | Theories, predictions |
| '''Contested''' | Disputed, multiple views | Debated topics, conflicting evidence |

=== 3.2 Setting Confidence Scores

'''Confidence Scale:'''

| Score | Meaning | Evidence Required |
|-------|---------|-------------------|
| 0.95-1.0 | Virtually certain | Multiple primary sources, replication |
| 0.80-0.94 | Highly confident | Primary sources, expert consensus |
| 0.60-0.79 | Moderately confident | Secondary sources, partial evidence |
| 0.40-0.59 | Tentative | Limited evidence, single source |
| 0.20-0.39 | Uncertain | Anecdotal, preliminary |
| 0.00-0.19 | Highly uncertain | Speculation, no evidence |

'''Template Usage:'''
```mediawiki
{{Epistemic_Marker
|confidence=High
|evidence=Primary sources
|status=Verified
}}
```

=== 3.3 Evidence Tiers

| Tier | Description | Examples |
|------|-------------|----------|
| '''T1''' | Primary sources | Raw data, experiments, direct observation |
| '''T2''' | Peer-reviewed research | Journal articles, conference papers |
| '''T3''' | Expert synthesis | Reviews, textbooks, expert opinions |
| '''T4''' | Secondary sources | News articles, blogs, summaries |
| '''T5''' | Tertiary sources | Encyclopedias, general references |

'''Marking Evidence:'''
```mediawiki
This claim is supported by recent research.[1]

== References ==
[1] Smith, J. (2025). "Title of Study." ''Journal Name'', 10(2), 100-120. {{Evidence_Tier|T2}}
```

----
== 4. Using Templates

=== 4.1 Document Header Template

'''Purpose:''' Standardize page metadata

'''Usage:'''
```mediawiki
{{Document_Header
|title=Page Title
|type=Concept
|author=Your Name
|date=2026-02-13
|confidence=0.75
|status=Emerging
}}
```

'''Result:'''
* Adds epistemic marker
* Sets SMW properties
* Displays metadata box

=== 4.2 Infobox Templates

'''Infobox_Concept:'''

|title=Recursive Systems
|definition=Systems that reference themselves
|examples=Fractals, Feedback loops
|domain=Systems Science
|confidence=0.80
|status=Established
}}
```

|description=Building recursive knowledge infrastructure
|status=Active
|steward=Hyperion
|confidence=0.90
}}
```

=== 4.3 Epistemic Templates

'''Epistemic_Marker:'''
```mediawiki

|confidence=High
|evidence=Primary sources
|status=Verified
}}
```

'''Uncertainty_Marker:'''
```mediawiki

|value=10.5

|confidence=0.85
}}
```

=== 4.4 Query Templates

'''Related_Entities:'''
```mediawiki

|entity={{FULLPAGENAME}}
|limit=10
}}
```

'''Domain_Index:'''
```mediawiki

|limit=20
}}
```

[[Has confidence::0.75]]
[[Has epistemic status::Emerging]]
